one_line: Major AI funding rounds and IPO preparations proceed amid a broader tech market sell-off and rising infrastructure pushback.

themes.title: OpenAI and Anthropic secure massive funding
themes.text: OpenAI closed $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic continues IPO plans despite a broader global tech sell-off and market rout.

stories.headline: Anthropic presses on with November IPO plans despite global AI stock sell-off
OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind

themes.title: Voter pushback targets data center expansion
themes.text: Following voter passage of multiple ballot measures restricting data center development in the US midterms, OpenAI changed its policies to end public official non-disclosure agreements and pay full electricity costs.

stories.headline: U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
OpenAI changes data center policies after midterm voter pushback

themes.title: Infrastructure shifts and workforce changes
themes.text: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows and ended an Oracle AI cloud rental agreement due to obsolete GPUs. Meanwhile, Google purchased Qualcomm shares and acquired a Wyoming data center site.

stories.headline: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows
Microsoft ends Oracle AI cloud rental as older Nvidia GPUs become obsolete
Google spends $548 million to buy about 3 million Qualcomm shares
Google acquires southeast Wyoming data center site from Crusoe

themes.title: Research advances and faster AI development
themes.text: Physical Superintelligence used an Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, and an independent analysis found Anthropic is developing systems twice as fast as last year.

stories.headline: Physical Superintelligence AI system proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
Ethan Mollick shares Anthropic data on AI impact across scientific fields
Anthropic developing AI systems twice as fast as a year ago, report says
